name: radio-group
title: Radio Group
purpose: Choose exactly one value from a visible, labelled set of mutually exclusive options with semantic selected color treatment.
accessibility: A native fieldset and legend name the group.
Native radio inputs preserve Arrow-key selection and one Tab stop for the checked option.
Hints and explicit errors are associated with every choice.
commonMistakes: Using cards without a visible legend.
Using radio choices when multiple values may be selected.
Removing native focus behavior from visually customized indicators.

examples.title: Column choices
examples.description: A compact vertical group preserves native single-choice behavior.
examples.source:
<script setup lang="ts">
import RadioGroup from "@/components/ui/RadioGroup.vue";
import { ref } from "vue";

const choice = ref("option-01");
const options = [
  { value: "option-01", label: "Option placeholder 01", description: "Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet." },
  { value: "option-02", label: "Option placeholder 02", description: "Consectetur adipiscing elit." },
  { value: "option-03", label: "Option placeholder 03", description: "Sed do eiusmod tempor." },
];
</script>

<template>
  <RadioGroup id="choice-placeholder" v-model="choice" label="Choice placeholder" :options="options" required hint="Helper text placeholder." />
</template>
